name: Kuwait Investment Company
founded: 1961 (incorporated 3 Dec 1961; described as Kuwait's first investment company)
ownership_summary: Listed on Boursa Kuwait; 62% owned by the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), its ultimate parent, per the audited FY2025 statements and the H1 2026 interim statements. Paid-up capital KD 55,125,000 (551.25m shares; 500,000 treasury shares at 30 Jun 2026).
government_link: Yes — 62% owned by the Kuwait Investment Authority, Kuwait's sovereign wealth fund (as of 30 Jun 2026). KIC also manages fiduciary portfolios for KIA and government agencies.
group_structure: Parent company with four operating sectors (Asset Management; Direct Investment & Corporate Finance; Treasury; Operations). Consolidated subsidiaries (FY2025): Kuwait Financial Brokerage Co. (45.47%, brokerage, controlled), Kuwait International Fair Co. (51%), Al Masar Leasing & Investment Co. (45.75%, Shariah-compliant leasing/investment, controlled), Arab Financial Services Co. (100%, brokerage), Kuwait Foreign Investment Co. (USA, 100%), Kuwait Maritime Transportation Co. (76%), Al Awaed Fund (100%), Al Hilal Islamic Fund (99.75%), KIC Capital Fund B.S.C. (Bahrain, 100%), KIC Bond Fund (under liquidation), MAJEL and WISALY S.A.R.L. (German real estate). Associate: National Hotels Company B.S.C. (Bahrain Bourse, 20.94%). Board (website, checked 2026-10-12): Bader Fawaz AlQattan (Chairman), Tameem Abdulaziz Al Mansour (Deputy Chairman, independent), Jamal Abdullah AlSaleem, Bader Nasser AlSubaiee, Fahad Mutlaq AlSheraian (independent), Bader Mohammad Alomairi, Abdullah Mohammad Alhadlaq, Aljazi Ali Almishwat, Lulwa Abdullatif Altherban.

capabilities.wealth_summary: KIC is Kuwait's oldest investment company (1961), 62% owned by the KIA, and its client business is dominated by fiduciary portfolios managed for KIA, government agencies and other institutions (KD 2.13bn at 30 Jun 2026, earning KD 5.5m of fees in FY2025). It runs four CMA-regulated funds (Al-Raed Investment Fund, NAV KD 217.4m at end 2025; Shariah-compliant Kuwait Investment Fund and KIC-GCC Equity Fund; Al Hilal Islamic money market fund), local, GCC and international discretionary portfolios, and relaunched a KIC Global Balanced Portfolio in May 2025. A dedicated Wealth Management unit for HNW clients was set up in 2025 under a new five-year strategy. KIC Trade gives online access to Kuwait, GCC, Egyptian, Hong Kong, Chinese and US markets (equities, ETFs, options, bonds and sukuk, margin), with e-KYC launched in 2025. KIC signed an exclusive agreement with Goldman Sachs Asset Management in H2 2025 to bring a foreign investment product to Kuwait, subject to regulatory approval.

private_banking.detail: Not a bank. HNW coverage is through the Wealth Management unit (see advisory).

asset_management.detail: Asset Management Sector: Local & Arab Funds Management, Local & Arab Portfolio Management (company-managed, client-managed and custody portfolios), International Funds & Portfolios. Fiduciary assets KD 2.13bn (30 Jun 2026). Funds: Al-Raed Investment Fund (NAV KD 217.4m, end 2025), Kuwait Investment Fund (Shariah), KIC-GCC Equity Fund (Shariah, launched 2003, 1.75% fee), Al Hilal Islamic Fund (Shariah money market, launched 2003, 1% fee), Al Awaed Fund; Real Estate Opportunity Fund under liquidation.

brokerage.detail: KIC Trade (Online Trading Department): Boursa Kuwait, DFM, Nasdaq Dubai, ADX, QSE, Tadawul, EGX, Hong Kong, China and US markets; equities, ETFs, US options, bonds and sukuk, margin trading. Also via subsidiaries Kuwait Financial Brokerage Co. (45.47%, Boursa broker with online platforms) and Arab Financial Services Co. (100%). Market maker for listed companies since 2022.

digital_investing.detail: KIC Trade on web, mobile and desktop with digital account opening (e-KYC at ekyc.kic.com.kw, launched 2025). Annual Report cites expansion of electronic trading platforms and plans for AI-enabled analytics.

advisory.detail: Wealth Management unit (2025): financial planning, portfolio management and specialised advisory for HNW individuals and institutions. Investment Research Unit covers Boursa Kuwait, GCC and MENA markets and provides advisory services. Investment banking advisory (M&A, capital raising, restructuring).

discretionary.detail: Company-managed portfolios (local, Arab and international) and fiduciary mandates where the Group makes investment decisions under the agreements.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: No robo or model-portfolio offering found; KIC Global Balanced Portfolio (relaunched May 2025) is a managed portfolio.

funds_platform.detail: No named third-party fund shelf. International portfolios invest in funds, and an exclusive agreement with Goldman Sachs Asset Management (H2 2025) aims to introduce a foreign investment product in Kuwait, pending regulatory approval.

structured_products.detail: None found on service pages or in the Annual Report 2025.

private_markets.detail: Proprietary direct investments (listed and unlisted, mainly MENA) and real estate (incl. Germany). Client portfolios 'may include alternative investments'; a client Real Estate Opportunity Fund is under liquidation. No current client private-markets product named.

islamic_wealth.detail: Shariah-compliant Kuwait Investment Fund and KIC-GCC Equity Fund (equities plus GCC government sukuk; external Shariah auditor Osool), Al Hilal Islamic money market fund (Shariah auditor Sharia Audit House since Jan 2025), Shariah-compliant stocks and sukuk on KIC Trade, and Shariah-compliant subsidiary Al Masar Leasing & Investment.
